Home.title: Studio Itai - your AI fitness coach
Home.description: Studio Itai builds you a personalized workout plan, tracks every session, and answers your training questions with an AI virtual trainer - guided by your real coach.
Home.feature1Body: Share your goals, fitness level, available days, and equipment in a short onboarding.
Home.feature2Body: Receive a structured weekly plan tailored to you, reviewed and refined by your coach.
Home.feature3Body: Log every workout, watch your progress, and ask your AI trainer anything, anytime.
